description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M0
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M0-06
**Implementation status:** Accepted after independent QA_PASS and explicit operator native acceptance; M0_VERIFIED. RSF-7 separately authorized by the operator.
**Responsible implementer:** Codex primary session. Independent read-only reviewer: configured forge_qa_reviewer /root/rsf6_independent_qa.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§4.7, 6/M0 scope 8 and gates, 7, 13
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Establish real native evidence for unchanged resources and report unresolved gates truthfully.

**Scope:** External pinned native recipe/harness, Novice body/head and representative Orc action/view/layer checks, consolidated gate verdict.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Record binary/source build identity, installed ACT/SPR hashes/path, requested action/view, resolved numeric ACT action/view slot, observed frame/layer sequence and fallback/modulo/substitution status.
- [x] Inspectable trace or labeled isolated presentation harness supports exact selection; screenshots/resource loading alone cannot yield REQUESTED_ACTION_VERIFIED.
- [x] Exercise player body/head views and representative monster actions/layers; unexplained rendering regressions require root-cause correction.
- [x] Report M0-S, M0-I, M0-N independently: M0_PASS requires all three. S+I pass with documented environment-blocked N yields M0_PARTIAL_NATIVE_UNVERIFIED, not PASS.
- [x] M1 structural work may proceed only on verified S+I and operator direction when N is environment-blocked; native failure suggesting codec/slot/source corruption blocks reliance on the affected path.

## Verification

Run actual pinned Korangar checks with artifact hashes, requested/resolved proof and operator native decision; otherwise NOT_RUN / NATIVE_UNVERIFIED plus blocker/next check. Independent reviewer verifies evidence.

Record actual commands, environment/tool versions, exit statuses, artifact hashes and NOT_RUN blockers at handoff. Actual execution and independent QA evidence are recorded below. Operator native approval is pending.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-4 (M0-04; task ID iemlbfn503r9pvc50xd8vbnd); RSF-5 (M0-05; task ID dpexmlk6wggb1xri9yefzjnq)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** No gameplay/source changes, no treating fallback as exact proof, no automatic M1 execution.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence

- Changed paths: tools/korangar-native/ (10 maintained source/config files); docs/evidence/rsf6/. Normal client/LWR/rAthena and accepted Python sources unchanged.
- Immutable Korangar revision 3f3d88a583203f09d079712f43343c1041258ffd; native debug executable SHA-256 38fa19a03469325d42570328d31128db5a0a37f821321f8428efb4df84d2ac76.
- Build source manifest SHA-256 5b3066f7b0ec11e729455d0e36c9471397efc5f31b4f5eab1e090e54ed21ad2c; final implementation manifest 87ee5ec5bc511eae9919b36dff9840396fd514ebae3e1dd5001fd33cd6d9fc77.
- Actual native loaders, animation state/selection/preparation/render, entity shader/drawer and WBOIT resolve execute on Vulkan llvmpipe. Six delivered ACT/SPR byte hashes match audited Novice body/head and Orc resources.
- 160 positive action/view cases, 1664 frame selections, 2688 independently checked prepared visible layers, 84 native capture observations; five fallback/modulo/hash/missing/view/direction diagnostics excluded from positive success.
- Two implementer runs and one independent reviewer run yield byte-identical report SHA-256 80b023d2b5cdc9a8bc59a8d643d425a6b4b2c7716d311727e0bbbc4f6a61c72e.
- Actual commands/exit statuses: see docs/evidence/rsf6/VERIFICATION.md. Native build/fmt/clippy -D warnings/test4; new Python9/public69/private10; oracle synthetic11/private3 AGREEMENT; installed distribution69: all exit0. Positive bad hash exits101 RESOURCE_MISMATCH before output creation.
- Native resource artifacts/captures private, no art in public distribution. Canonical technical trace retained as native-report.json.gz.
- Git HEAD f1bb19bb130beea8b89cf6c029209e93fb241d5a; accepted97-file manifest/archive preserved and unchanged. No commit/push/reset/clean.

## Independent QA result

QA_PASS — configured forge_qa_reviewer /root/rsf6_independent_qa, separate read-only context; no implementation/evidence edits or Kaneo writes. Independently reproduced actual native rendering/selection, loader-byte hashes, all84 capture hashes/dimensions/nonbackground counts, fresh89-upstream/120-generated source snapshot, build and listed regressions. Report tampering and malformed expectations rejected. No blocking findings or unexplained rendering regressions. Full verdict: docs/evidence/rsf6/QA_REVIEW.md.

## M0 gates and operator decision

- M0-S = PASS (accepted preservation/structural evidence retained, fresh relevant tests).
- M0-I = PASS (accepted independent decoder, fresh synthetic/private parity).
- Native technical checks = PASS within isolated presentation scope; formal M0-N = UNVERIFIED / OPERATOR_DECISION_PENDING.
- Overall M0 = NOT_YET_ACCEPTED; do not claim M0_VERIFIED until operator native decision is obtained.
- Operator native decision requested against docs/evidence/rsf6/M0_GATE_PACKET.md. Remain QA Review pending decision. This is not an environment-blocked native run.
- visual_review=NOT_REQUIRED for unchanged reference artwork. Gameplay reachability/audio/hardware GPU/full-scene lighting/cross-platform pixel parity NOT_TESTED.
- RSF-7 remains Backlog, blockers RSF-4/5 Accepted; no M1 work started.


## Operator acceptance and current M0 closure — 2026-10-30

Explicit operator decision recorded 2026-10-30: “I ACCEPT the RSF-6 native Korangar verification evidence for the declared M0 scope.” The operator adopts independent forge_qa_reviewer QA_PASS and the exact pinned evidence (executable 38fa19a03469325d42570328d31128db5a0a37f821321f8428efb4df84d2ac76; native report 80b023d2b5cdc9a8bc59a8d643d425a6b4b2c7716d311727e0bbbc4f6a61c72e): 160 positive action/view cases, 1664 frame selections, 2688 visible layer occurrences, Novice body/head and Orc multilayer playback, fallback detection and repeatable reports. M0-S=PASS; M0-I=PASS; M0-N=PASS; M0=M0_VERIFIED. Acceptance covers the tested pinned native presentation configuration only. It does not establish ordinary gameplay reachability, physical GPU/cross-platform equivalence, audible playback, full-scene lighting/shadows or new-art approval. Unchanged artwork visual_review=NOT_REQUIRED. No technical failure after QA is reported. All five criteria remain checked. Existing technical evidence and prior pending-decision history are preserved. Operator separately authorizes RSF-7 implementation in this assignment; no RSF-8 work.

The preceding pending-decision statements describe the historical QA handoff and are superseded by this explicit decision. Current M0-S=PASS, M0-I=PASS, M0-N=PASS, overall M0_VERIFIED.
